title: What Codex unlocks for Notion
summary: How Notion uses Codex to one-shot specs, build AI Voice Input for the web, and multiply engineering power across small teams.
body: How Notion uses Codex to one-shot specs, build AI Voice Input for the web, and multiply engineering power across small teams.
summaryZh: Notion分享了他们如何使用Codex快速将产品规格书转化为实际代码，并构建了网页端的AI语音输入功能。案例表明先进代码大模型能显著放大各规模工程团队的生产力。原始信息显示：How Notion uses Codex to one-shot specs, build AI Voice Input for the web, and multiply engineering power across small teams.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“What Codex unlocks for Notion”。其重要性主要体现在：报道了Notion如何借助Codex提升小型团队研发效能并完成AI语音输入等功能。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
